sources.use: Generation-stamped cache-capsule ownership, external build staging/adoption, deadline fallback, late-result disposal, and bounded engagement counters.
Design inputs only: save identity, explicit token-count validation, per-entry corruption detection, and exact compatibility gating.

mlx2_changes: Kept APCv2 as the sole cache engine and added a default-off transient B1-to-Bn physical fanout boundary.
Bound every capsule to complete APC model, revision, adapter, tokenizer, cache-layout, semantic, and runtime-layout identity.
Reserved APCv2 resident capacity before publication and repeated the generation check after reservation.
Added ownership leases, first-consumer synchronization, one-worker external staging, deadline fallback, and late-result disposal.
Wired a qualification-only ordinary-serving path that prepares exact warm APCv2 fanout, transfers ownership into BatchGenerator, records per-request engagement receipts, and falls back atomically.

Required external adapters to stage allowlisted host-only buffers; worker threads are rejected before launch for MLX arrays or opaque wrappers, and stale/adoption/final-validation faults terminalize and dispose exactly once.
Added optional block-granular APCv2 disk snapshots with per-block and whole-file SHA-256 manifests, strict contained block paths, orphan cleanup, save identity, and logical token-count checks.
Made fanout attachment all-or-nothing across pending member removal, queued cancellation, and bind exceptions; inserted lanes are rolled back before terminal publication.
Declined capsule preparation when occupied scheduler width cannot attach every sibling before the next step, with an explicit per-request fallback receipt.

Reserved and generation-validated the complete mixed prepared-cache Bn footprint transactionally before any capsule build or ordinary merge, with per-plane byte claims, no double charge, and release after the final consumer.

Allowed mixed model caches to capsule at least one exact plain-KV plane while preserving unsupported mergeable planes through the ordinary batch merge; live Muse GPU evidence found and closed the previous all-planes gate.
Retained ordinary whole-file snapshots when persistent_block_bytes is zero.

validation.gpu: Apple GPU mechanism smokes on 2026-09-18: exact final implementation commit bb882313c6434abb56e709a9f035b323352c9035 live Muse Glimmer B1-to-B2 fanout leased the 108-token committed APCv2 boundary and engaged a 52-plane mixed prepared cache (13 capsule plus 39 ordinary planes) for both siblings. Direct APCv2 persistence restored 511 tokens from nine verified blocks; synthetic GPU capsule construction used backend=gpu with raw-bit verification. These are observed-use/correctness smokes, not performance or production qualification.
